Days, times, and instructors for each program — updated as new classes open. On some days, more than one class runs at the same time, so check each card for its specific schedule.

More classes are added here as they open for the season — Textile & Sewing (taught by Ms. Lily) launches November 7.

One registration gets your child into every class.

Registering enrolls your child in the full P4PCV Academy — there's no need to pick individual programs. Once registered, your child can take part in any open class: Art, Boot Camp, Recyclers, and every program as it opens.
